messages.subject: Meeting tomorrow...R Markdown presentation
parts:
Hi folks,

Just a quick reminder, I'll be hosting the D-RUG session tomorrow, same time, same place (Tuesday 1:10-3 in Wickson 2124). 

I'll be talking about using Markdown documents as part of RStudio, and how versatile Markdown can be. It's possible to generate reports, interactive analyses, slide presentations, etc., all with very simple code (and essentially a text editor). I'll give a few examples and provide a brief overview on how to integrate the dynamic "shiny" package within a Markdown document. All great tools for data analysis and reporting. Here's RStudio's official page on Markdown.

As usual, feel free to come by whether you have questions, have work on your own projects (including classwork), or you'd simply like to eat a few cookies. 

Adios,
Ryan
